{{WotQ|Loial}}
'''Loial (pronounced: LOY-ahl) son of [[Arent]] son of [[Halan]]''' is an [[Ogier]] born and raised in [[Stedding Shangtai]].{{ref/book|1|42}}

== Appearance ==
He stands tall, almost ten feet, and like all Ogier his face has a broad, almost snout-like nose, and eyebrows that hang down like tails framing pale eyes as big as teacups. His ears poke up to tufted points through shaggy black hair, and twitch when his emotions are running high. His voice is as deep as a drum. His smile splits his face in two, and shows teeth as broad as chisels. His fingers are broad enough for three, on hands big enough for hams. He is considered young amongst Ogier, at about ninety years old.{{ref/book|1|36}}

He has just recently tried to grow a mustache and beard. He has fine hair on his top lip, with a patch of hair on his chin.
[[File:Loial.JPG|left|thumb|243x243px]]

== History ==
Hasty for an Ogier, he is said to act an hour before he thinks. He loves books and reading, never being anywhere without a book. The fastest runner in Stedding Shangtai, he once outran a horse. As his name suggests, he is loyal to his friends. He believes firmly in life, and the preservation of it, especially trees. He is one of the most gifted [[treesinger]]s in many years.{{ref/book|1|42}}

== Relationships ==
Loial is son of [[Covril]] (mother)  and Arent (father). By Ogier naming conventions, his paternal grandfather is Haran and his maternal grandmother is Ella. Similarly his maternal great-grandmother is Soong. His teacher is Elder [[Haman]], who is also his uncle through marriage to his mother's sister.

He is married to [[Erith]].

==Activities==
=== Flight to the Two Rivers ===

Leaving the ''[[stedding]]'' before he was of an age to do so, he traveled to the great cities to view the [[Ogier grove]]s, but found the [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhienin]] grove degenerated into a common forest, the [[Caemlyn]] and [[Tear (city)|Tairen]] groves destroyed, and the [[Illian (city)|Illianer]] grove inaccessible (it is part of the king's park and hunting grounds). In [[Caemlyn]], he met [[Rand al'Thor]] while in the [[Queen's Blessing]] inn. Knowing the [[Ways]], and able to read them, he joined Rand's group and guided them them to [[Fal Dara]].

He traveled into the [[Blight]] with Rand's group, where they met the [[Green Man]]. Loial was deeply saddend by death of the [[Green Man]]. He sang to the oak tree that sprouted from Someshta's death, making it healthier and stronger, in the hope that the [[Great Blight|Blight]] would not overcome it.{{ref/book|1|53}}

He traveled with [[Ingtar Shinowa]], following [[Padan Fain]] to [[Falme]]. He then followed Rand to [[Tear]] with [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], and [[Perrin Aybara]]. From there he assisted Perrin through the Ways to the [[Two Rivers]]{{ref/book|4|18}} and helped him purge the district of [[Shadowspawn]]. While in the Two Rivers, he closed and locked the [[Waygate]] at [[Manetheren]] permanently.{{ref/book|4|53}} During the [[Battle of Emond's Field]], he wielded two wood axes to fight the Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|56}}

During his adventures with Rand, [[Matrim Cauthon]], and Perrin, he decided to write a book about the events unfolding around the ''[[ta'veren]]''. He often spent confrontations and battles feverishly writing in his notes.{{ref/book|7|2}} 

Always fearful of being married off, he continually worried about his mother, [[Covril]], finding him. Even though he found [[Erith]] of [[Stedding Tsofu]] very attractive, he didn't like to admit it too loudly.{{ref/book|7|4}}

=== Dumai's Wells ===
After returning from the Two Rivers, he stops at a ''stedding'' to recuperate and then reunites with [[Rand]] and Perrin again in Caemlyn. When tension arises between [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|Faile Bashere]] and Perrin in Cairhien, Loial is caught in the middle. 
[[File:Loial.jpg|thumb|311x311px|Loial Portrait by Seamus Gallagher]]
When he finds out Rand has been kidnapped by the [[White Tower]], he leaves with Perrin to find him. He fights alongside Perrin and [[Aram]] at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|6|55}}

[[File:Loial.jpeg|thumb|left|Loial from the [[CCG]]]]

=== Warning the Elders ===
Later, he began [[Traveling]] with the [[Asha'man]] [[Karldin Manfor]] from ''stedding'' to ''stedding'' to warn the Ogier [[Elder (Ogier)|Elders]] that [[Shadowspawn]] were using the [[Ways]].{{ref/book|10|2}}

He arrived back in [[Cairhien]] with Karldin looking for Rand. They arrived on the scene shortly after [[Dobraine Taborwin]] was stabbed and nearly murdered in his chambers. He found a note indicating the assailants were looking for something.

He then Traveled with [[Davram Bashere]] and [[Logain Ablar]] to find Rand in [[Tear]]. He reported to Rand that the [[Borderland]] and [[Shadow Coast]] ''stedding'' ignored him, but everyone else were now guarding their Waygates. Rand sent Loial, Davram, and Logain to arrange a meeting between himself and the [[Seanchan]].
[[File:WoT261.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Loial from the WoT comic]]
Loial's mother Covril finally caught up with him at [[Algarin Pendaloan]]'s mansion in Tear. There, she made sure Elder [[Haman]] married Loial and [[Erith]]. After the Trollocs attacked the mansion, Loial convinced his mother that he needed to speak to the [[Great Stump]] about Ogier joining forces with humankind for [[Tarmon Gai'don]], rather than using [[Book of Translation]] to flee to another world. Loial's mentor, Elder Haman, concurred with him and believed Loial had the makings of a great scholar.{{ref/book|11|19}}

=== The Last Battle ===
Following the conclusion of the Great Stump, Loial and all the Ogier arrived at the [[Field of Merrilor]]. There, they saw the [[Great Tree]]s that Rand grew during his signing of the [[Dragon's Peace]]. The Ogier pledged to fight alongside humankind at the [[Last Battle]]. Loial and the rest of the Ogier fight with Queen [[Elayne Trakand]]'s army and the [[Children of the Light]]. In combat, the Ogier sing a terrifying death song, hacking fiercely at Trollocs around them.

== In the television series ==
* In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]], {{TVlink|Loial}} is played by actor {{TVlink|Hammed Animashaun}}.
